description: Synthetic sesslint.adapters.codex_rollout parity (detection, constants, loader seams, and documented session/hash gaps).
known_parity_gaps: GAP-codex-secret-scan-tracker: load_codex_rollout with a supplied SecretScanTracker stops at sesslint.checks.hygiene.SecretScanTracker. Rust returns that seam before path, size, or SQLite handling.
GAP-codex-session-envelope: load_codex_rollout_session on success would build sesslint.canonical.Session. Rust stops at Session and does not read events into an envelope.
GAP-codex-content-hash: _process_jsonl_line and successful envelope classification stop at sesslint._canonical_codec.payload_content_hash before appending events the pin would emit.
GAP-codex-finding-fingerprint: loader gates that call make_finding in the pin stop at sesslint.determinism.canonical_json_bytes when the fingerprint is omitted. Findings are not appended.
